about: The comment sweep's rows for the key-remnants cut (docs/dev/E54/COMMENT-SWEEP.md), built by tools/e54/sweep-build.mjs from 421f2395 and applied by tools/e54/sweep.mjs after split.mjs and repoint.mjs. Each row: the line at the base (base), the file it stands in after the cut (file), the changed fragment of it there (old), what the fragment reads instead (new), and the whole line at the base (line): sweep.mjs applies a fragment that stands once in the file, or else the one that stands in a line equal to `line`, and refuses the row otherwise.
